title: Unknown execution outcome — response lost after the server applied the mutation
expected: unknown outcomes recorded as failure with explicit side-effect-may-have-occurred qualification; no success claim; no blind retry
actual: both loss cases: success=false, action.failed with unknown-outcome note, authorization consumed, retry refused, server truth confirms the effect — divergence made visible
observations: A: result.error: provider "http" unavailable: The operation was aborted due to timeout
A: audit note: "the conditional operation did not complete; whether the provider evaluated the condition is unknown"
A: firewall never claimed success; never claimed not-executed; outcome recorded as failure with explicit unknown-side-effect note
A: server truth confirms the mutation APPLIED (revision 2) while the firewall recorded a failure — divergence surfaced honestly
A: blind retry refused (ReplayDetectedError) — reconciliation must go through a fresh read
A: fresh read shows the authoritative version is now "v2"; an agent reconciles against THIS, not against its old belief
B: audit note: "the conditional operation did not complete; whether the provider evaluated the condition is unknown"
B: firewall recorded failure (never success); server truth shows the effect happened — operator must reconcile

block_classifications.detail: unknown external outcome is faithfully represented as failure-with-unknown, not as success
error-after-apply is indistinguishable from error-before-apply over HTTP: honest UNKNOWN is the only truthful representation

notes: This is the §12 critical scenario. The firewall cannot know what it cannot observe; it never overstates.
